description: This file defines the 'LoanTransaction' entity in a microfinance or banking application, modeling various monetary transactions related to loans such as disbursements, repayments, waivers, fees, and adjustments. It includes methods for creating, updating, reversing, and managing loan transactions, as well as handling relationships with other domain entities.

classes.name: LoanTransaction
classes.description: Entity representing all monetary transactions against a loan, including disbursements, repayments, fees, waivers, and adjustments. It maintains relationships with other domain entities and provides methods for transaction management, reversal, and relation handling.
